contributions.title: No Gold-type mechanism on the subgroup of order n; an inverse statement is posed
KKH at a fixed gap has exponent 0; lower bounds depend on k mod n/s
Exponent ledger: DKT's method gives 27 at gap 0.2 and about 2,200 at gap 0.1
Coset family: C(s - 1, d + 1) bad challenges per point at gap 1/s
Negative search: no growing list at slack 0.2496 in large characteristic
Characteristic two: a quadratic count at the T1 agreement, rediscovering TR26-237
Lean: the uncovered-point lemma and the characteristic-two counts, against ArkLib
A linear T1 bound forces constant lists beyond Johnson
At least 3.12n with leftover points: any T1Uniform constant is at least 3.12
At least 3n bad challenges on the subgroup of order n, at rates just above 1/4
